user.title: Connect to Apex
user.description: Enter your Apex host/IP and credentials. **admin** is recommended because it's commonly preconfigured, but it's not required. If you also use the Apex local web UI, use a dedicated account for Home Assistant (sharing the same account between multiple local logins can cause issues). If you set up more than one local integration/HA instance against the same controller, use separate Apex accounts.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Apex
reauth_confirm.description: Update credentials for {host}. Tip: use a dedicated Apex account for Home Assistant (avoid sharing an account with the local web UI or other local integrations).

reconfigure_confirm.title: Reconfigure Apex
reconfigure_confirm.description: Update host and/or credentials for {host}. The connection type is detected once and then kept; tick the re-detect box only if the controller was upgraded or was set up while it was misbehaving.

abort.already_configured: This Apex controller is already configured. Credentials were updated and the entry will reload.
abort.different_device: This entry is already bound to a different Apex controller. Remove the integration and add it again to switch devices.

error.rate_limited: The controller is rate limiting logins. Try again in a few minutes.

firmware_install_unconfirmed.title: Apex firmware install not confirmed
firmware_install_unconfirmed.description: Home Assistant asked {name} to install new firmware, but the controller did not report a new firmware version within 20 minutes. The install was not retried. Check the controller locally (its status LED and its web UI), follow Neptune's recovery steps if it is unresponsive, then reload this integration.
